abilities.name: Siegebreaker
abilities.description:
For the next 20 seconds, the cooldown reduction granted by your Veteran of War is doubled.
While Siegebreakeris active, you take 25% reduced damage and your Shield Slam, Shield Throw and Shockwave abilities deal 25% increased damage.
SPIRIT ABILITY
When you activate your Spirit ability you gain Spirit of Heroism, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description:
Taunt the target, forcing it to attack you for 6 sec.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description:
Interrupt the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec.
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Iron Wall
abilities.description:
Your Toughness can not be reduced for 12 seconds.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Grand Melee
abilities.description:
For the next 10 seconds, Incite all enemies in a large radius around you, forcing them to only use Auto Attacks and only attack you.
All allies within the radius of Grand Melee take 20% reduced magic damage while it is active.

name: Helena
description:
Despite being weighed down by full plate armor, Helena is always ready to charge into the fray to protect her companions.

Helena is a Melee Tank and excels in the front lines taking hits instead of her allies.

Her Veteran of War mechanic allows Helena to reduce the cooldowns of her ability to allow for more frequent use of her powerful attacks and Toughness generators.

Toughness is Helena's main resource for mitigating incoming damage and surviving dangerous encounters. Her Toughness is shown as a blue bar to the right of the character.

talents.name: The Best Defense
talents.description:
Each time you Block an attack with your shield, you have a chance to reset the cooldown of Shield Throw. Your next Shield Throw within 12 seconds deals 20% increased damage.
(2.0 PPM)

talents.name: Shield Mastery
talents.description: The cooldown of your Shields Up and Shield Throw abilities are reduced relative to the amount of damage you mitigate with Toughness.

talents.name: Sword & Board
talents.description:
Your Power Strike has a chance to grant you Empowered Shield Slam for 12 seconds, causing your next Shield Slam to apply an absorb on you for 2000% Strength that lasts for 8 seconds.
(1.0 PPM)

talents.name: Reinforced Steel
talents.description: Your Armor is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Guarded Veteran
talents.description: Your chance to Block is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Punishing Strikes
talents.description: Your Power Strike and Shield Slam deal 15% increased damage.

talents.name: Aftershock
talents.description: Enemies that take damage from your Shockwave ability take 30% more damage from you for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Razor Shrapnel
talents.description: Your Shield Throw hits have a 20% chance to trigger an explosion of metal, dealing damage equal to 40% of the Shield Throw hit that triggered the explosion to the target and up to 7 additional nearby enemies.

talents.name: Skull Cracker
talents.description: Your Shield Throw has 20% additional Critical Strike chance and deals 100% increased damage to the first target it hits.

talents.name: Sharpened Blade
talents.description: Enemies affliced by your Sweeping Strike's bleed have 20% reduced attack speed.

talents.name: High Command
talents.description: Your "Hold the Line" cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds each time you use Shields Up.

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% less Magic damage.

talents.name: Commander's Advance
talents.description: Your "Hold the Line" ability increases your movement speed by 50% and the movement speed of your allies by 25% for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.description: When your Toughness has reduced an amount of damage equal to 50% of your Maximum Health, you gain 30% increased Strength for 8 sec.

talents.name: Martial Command
talents.description:
While Siegebreaker is active you deal 25% more damage and your damage reduction from Toughness is shared with all allies.
Your Spirit is increased by +5% passively.

talents.name: Gleaming Shield
talents.description: While Shields up is active your Shield Slam deals 40% increased damage and all healing effects on you are increased by 20%.

talents.name: Front Line Defender
talents.description: The efficiency of your Toughness mechanic is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Master of War
talents.description: Your Grand Melee ability has 20% reduced cooldown.

talents.name: Greater Shockwave
talents.description: Your Shockwave deals 20% increased damage.

lore: Helena is a stern presence within the Fellowship, maintaining a seasoned warrior’s discipline. She uses both the shield she wields to protect others, and to distance herself becoming too familiar with her companions, lest she suffer the burden of loss again.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Jubilee
abilities.description:
Call upon Dream Flutterflies to protect up to 4 players by evenly distributing all health between them every 2 seconds over 10 sec.
Upon arriving, the Dream Flutterflies cause 6 Prickly Vines to spontaneously spawn near you.
SPIRIT ABILITY
When you activate your Spirit ability you gain Spirit of Heroism, granting +30% Haste and +600% Mana Recovery for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Heart Bloom
abilities.description:
Conjure a Heart Bloom at your side that stores 15% of all Flutterfly healing you do inside it.
Every 3 seconds, the Heart Bloom releases a pulse, healing all allies within 4000 radius for an amount equal to the healing it has stored. Lasts 15 seconds.
Heart Bloom spawns 3 Boomshrooms when it withers.

abilities.name: Cure Ailment
abilities.description: Remove all Harmful Magic Effects from target ally.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Protect
abilities.description:
Send your Blue Flutterfly to protect target ally.
While your Blue Flutterfly is attached to an ally, that player receives 150% increased healing from your Flutterfly Healing effects.
While the Blue Flutterfly is on you, Your Flutterfly Healing on all allies is increased by 50% and all your abilities have 20% reduced mana cost.

abilities.name: Hidden Trail
abilities.description:
Your Movement Speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.
Demure
Upon activating Hidden Trail your threat is reduced by 50% with all enemies.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Iron Bark
abilities.description:
Target ally takes 20% reduced damage for 12 seconds.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Safe Haven
abilities.description: Place a Safe Haven in target location. For the next 15 seconds, all allies standing within the radius have 40% increased healing taken.

abilities.name: Enfeebling Rootsap
abilities.description:
Command one of your Prickly Vines to Enfeeble target enemy, reducing all damage that enemy deals by 20% for 6 seconds.
The Prickly Vine withers upon completing it's cast of Enfeebling Rootsap.

abilities.name: Fluttercall: Embrace
abilities.description:
Recall your Blue Flutterfly to you.
While the Blue Flutterfly is on you, Your Flutterfly Healing on all allies is increased by 50% and all your abilities have 20% reduced mana cost.
While your Blue Flutterfly is attached to an ally, that player receives 150% increased healing from your Flutterfly Healing effects.

name: Sylvie
description:
Sylvie is a healer who uses her innate connection to nature and its many friends to heal her allies and harm her foes.

Sylvie is a Healer that uses Pet Management Mechanics. She excels at sending her pets to heal her allies over time and attack her enemies.

She commands her Flutterflies and Plants to heal, while her Boomshrooms to attack enemies.

Her powerful Heal over Time spells allow her to prepare for battle and endure long and sustained fights.

talents.name: Nettle to the Petal
talents.description: Each time you deal damage with Nettlebolt, your Life Petal triggers an additional tick of its healing.

talents.name: Synchronized Fluttering
talents.description:
Hold down Fluttercall: Heal for 2 seconds to overcharge it, causing the ability to be cast on up to 4 allies within 4000 range in one cast. The mana cost is increased by 100% when cast in this way.
Overcharged Abilities
Hold down the relevant ability button until a cast bar is displayed. Once the cast has completed, the overcharged version of the ability will trigger.

talents.name: Verdant Restoration
talents.description: The initial heal of your Fluttercall: Restore Life has +50% increased critical strike chance.

talents.name: Sprouting Nettles
talents.description:
Each tick of Flutterfly Healing has a chance to make your next Nettlebolt instant cast and have +100% critical strike chance.
(4.0 PPM)
GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a grievous critical strike. Grievous critical strikes increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.

talents.name: Natural Knowledge
talents.description: Each time your Nettlebolt deals damage, you replenish 1% mana.

talents.name: Trailing Restoration
talents.description: The duration of your Fluttercall: Restore Life is increased by 9 seconds.

talents.name: Elusive Wildling
talents.description: You take 20% reduced damage while Hidden Trail is active.

talents.name: Will of Nature
talents.description: Your healing is increased by 25% on players with 30% or less health.

talents.name: Rowdy Rootsap
talents.description: Your Enfeebling Rootsap causes the target and all enemies within a 700 radius of the target to have 20% reduced attack speed and 50% reduced movement speed while active.

talents.name: Nurtured Haven
talents.description:
The cooldown of your Safe Haven is reduced each time one of your plants wither.
Prickly Vine - 1 second
Life Petal - 2 seconds
Heart Bloom - 3 seconds

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% less Magic damage.

talents.name: Spirited Fortitude
talents.description: You take 10% less Area of effect damage.

talents.name: Natural Protector
talents.description: Your Iron Bark and Safe Haven abilities shield players for 15 seconds, absorbing up to 1421% intellect damage.

talents.name: Flutterswift
talents.description: Your Fluttercall: Heal ticks 100% faster for the first 12 seconds each time it begins healing a player.

talents.name: Flower Power
talents.description:
Your Heart Bloom has 2 charges but only accumulates 10% of all Flutterfly Healing.
The recharge rate of your Heart Bloom is affected by Haste.

talents.name: Bluey's Gambit
talents.description:
While your Blue Flutterfly is following you, you take 5% reduced damage.
While your Blue Flutterfly is following another player, they take 5% reduced damage.

talents.name: Bloomin' Boomshrooms
talents.description:
Your Shroomsplosion ability can now target allies, sending up to 3 Boomshrooms to detonate on them, instantly healing them for 308% Intellect each.
When targeting allies in this way, the Boomshroom still deals its normal damage to nearby enemies.

talents.name: Symbiosis
talents.description: All your Flutterfly Healing is increased by 3% for each Prickly Vine you have active.

talents.name: Spirited Advance
talents.description: Your Movement Speed is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Bursting Petals
talents.description:
Your Life Petal's healing is increased by 20% and its healing is front loaded, causing the first tick to heal for twice the amount and ramping down with each tick thereafter.
- NUUKED - waiting for new talent that procs ticks on Life Petal when Nettlebolt deals damage - Axel

talents.name: Shroomageddon
talents.description: Your Shroomsplosion deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: In Bloom
talents.description: Your Heart Bloom's mana cost is reduced by 25%.

talents.name: Heavy Nettle
talents.description: Your Nettlebolt deals 40% increased damage.

talents.name: Green Thumb
talents.description:
The healing of your Life Petal, Heartbloom, and Rootsap Revival is increased by 20%.
- Nuked for new talent revision -

lore: Abandoned at a young age, Sylvie was taken in and raised by the forest itself. She spent her childhood under the protection of its boughs and learning the natural cycles of magic from her friends, the Flutterflies.

abilities.name: Wrath of Winter
abilities.description:
Invoke the spirits of the frozen tundra for 20 seconds, granting you 1 Winter Orb every 4 seconds. You deal +25% increased damage and your Glacial Blast ability is instant cast while Wrath of Winter is active.
WINTER ORBS
Winter Orbs are required to cast your powerful spender abilities; Glacial Blast and Ice Comet.
SPIRIT ABILITY
When you activate your Spirit ability you gain Spirit of Heroism, granting +30% Haste for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Ice Dash
abilities.description:
Quickly travel forward a short distance.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Frost Ward
abilities.description:
You take 40% reduced damage for 4 seconds.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Brain Freeze
abilities.description:
Interrupt the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec.
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Frigid Winds
abilities.description:
Blast enemies in front of you with arctic winds, Knocking Back enemies and Slowing them by 50% for 12 sec.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Ice Blitz
abilities.description:
You enter a state of focused casting for 20 seconds, causing you to deal 20% more damage for the duration.
Can be used during Global Cooldown and while casting

abilities.name: Winter's Blessing
abilities.description:
Your Spirit is increased by 20% for 20 seconds and 30% of all damage you deal is replicated as healing divided equally between all allies.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

name: Rime
description:
Channelling the forces of spirit and ice, Rime conjures powerful spells to decimate her foes.

Rime is a Spellcasting Damage Dealer with Builder/Spender Mechanics. She excels at focusing down the biggest threat from a distance.

Many of Rime’s abilities fill an Anima Bar to deal spikes of damage and generate Winter Orbs.

She uses Winter Orbs to cast dangerous spells.

talents.name: Chilling Finesse
talents.description:
Each tick of Freezing Torrent reduces the cooldown of Bursting Ice by 0.3 seconds.
Each time you cast Cold Snap the cooldown of Freezing Torrent is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Winter's Embrace
talents.description:
While Bursting Ice is active on an enemy you gain Winter's Embrace, causing you to deal 20% more damage.
Winter's Embrace does not affect Bursting Ice.

talents.name: Glacial Assault
talents.description: Your Cold Snap ability grants you 1 stack of Glacial Assault. Once you have 4 stacks of Glacial Assault, your next Glacial Blast is instant cast, deals 40% more damage and has no cost.

talents.name: Burstbolter
talents.description: When your Frost Bolt deals damage to an enemy, it triggers a single pulse of Bursting Ice and generates 2 additional Anima.

talents.name: Talon's Edict
talents.description:
Your Cold Snap critical strikes conjure 3 Frost Swalllows to instantly attack your enemies.
Additionally, your Cold Snap and Freezing Torrent damage has a 15% chance to conjure 1 Frost Swalllow.

talents.name: Navir's Keeper
talents.description: Your Flight of the Navir ability grants 2 charges of Cold Snap.

talents.name: Icy Flow
talents.description:
Your Cold Snap grants you Icy Flow for 8 seconds, reducing the cast time of your next Glacial Blast by 0.5 seconds or reducing the impact delay of your next Ice Comet by 0.5 seconds.
Both abilities gain +25% increased critical strike chance when consuming a stack of Icy Flow.
You can have up to 2 stacks of Icy Flow.

talents.name: Avalanche
talents.description: Your Ice Comet has a 15% chance to strike twice, and a 7% chance to strike three times.

talents.name: Coalescing Frost
talents.description:
Each hit of Freezing Torrent infuses the target with Coalescing Frost for 3 seconds. Once it expires, the afflicted enemy releases a pulse of frost damage in an area around them, dealing 43% Intellect damage for each stack of Coalescing Frost that was infused.
Freezing Torrent critical strikes have a 50% chance to apply 2 stacks of Coalescing Frost.

talents.name: Tundra Guard
talents.description: Your Frost Ward duration is increased by 2 seconds and while it is active, you heal for 50% of all damage you deal.

talents.name: Greater Glacial Blast
talents.description: Your Glacial Blast deals 40% more damage but its cast time is increased by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% reduced Magic damage.

talents.name: Cascading Blitz
talents.description:
For each Anima you generate while your Ice Blitz is active, you conjure 1 Frost Swallow to attack your target.
The duration of Ice Blitz is extended by 0.2 seconds each time a Frost Swallow hits an enemy.

talents.name: Frostweaver's Wrath
talents.description:
Each time you generate Winter Orbs, you have a 17% chance to gain Frostweaver's Wrath for 12 seconds, causing the next Glacial Blast or Ice Comet that deals damage to have 100% additional critical strike chance.
GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a grievous critical strike. Grievous critical strikes increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.

talents.name: Soulfrost Torrent
talents.description:
Each time you cast an ability you have a chance to gain Soulfrost Torrent for 18 seconds, causing your next Freezing Torrent to have 40% increased tick rate and +100% increased critical strike chance. (1.5 PPM)
GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a grievous critical strike. Grievous critical strikes increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.

talents.name: Biting Cold
talents.description: The power of your Critical Strikes is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Spirited Fortitude
talents.description: You take 10% less Area of Effect damage.

talents.name: Wisdom of the North
talents.description: The cooldown of Ice Blitz, Flight of the Navir & Winter's Blessing is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each Winter's Orb you spend.

talents.name: Talon's Edict (old)
talents.description: Your Cold Snap conjures an additional wave of 3 Frost Swallows in waves.

talents.name: Harrowing Ice (old)
talents.description: Your Bursting Ice damage is increased by 30%.

talents.name: Coalescing Ice (old)
talents.description: When Bursting Ice deals damage to a single target it generates 2 additional Anima per tick.

talents.name: Chillblain (old)
talents.description: Your Freezing Torrent deals 20% increased damage.

talents.name: Spirited Advance (old)
talents.description: Your Movement Speed is increased by 20%

talents.name: Greater Glacial Blast (old)
talents.description: Your Glacial Blast has 20% increased critical strike chance.

talents.name: Wicked Blitz (old)
talents.description: Your Ice Blitz increases all damage you deal by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Chilling Finesse (old)
talents.description: While Bursting Ice is active on an enemy, you gain 20% Haste.

talents.name: Soulfrost Torrent (old)
talents.description:
Your critical strikes have a chance to cause your next Freezing Torrent within 12 seconds to have 100% increased tick rate and deal 100% increased damage.
(1.5 PPM)

lore: Blessed or maybe cursed by the spirits of the land, Rime was given the the ability to manipulate the flows of Anima around her. A skill that her tribe thought lost to their past. She uses this ability to manipulate the water and ice around her, teaching her enemies to respect the elemental forces.

abilities.name: Remove Magic
abilities.description: Remove all Harmful Magic Effects from target ally.

abilities.name: Lightshaper's Ward
abilities.description:
Target ally takes 20% reduced damage for 12 seconds.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Runic Proliferation
abilities.description:
Instantly generate 3 Radiant Runes. For the next 8 seconds, any Rune Abilities you cast are empowered, increasing their effectiveness by 20%.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description:
Your movement speed is increased by 50% for 6 seconds.
Levitation
You take 20% reduced Area of Effect damage while levitating.
Can be used during Global Cooldown and while Casting or Channeling

name: Vigour
description:
As a dwarf who divines the true meaning of runes, Vigour wields powerful healing spells to bolster and protect his allies and smite his enemies.

Vigour is a Healer that uses Builder/Spender Mechanics. He excels in the middle of his allies where he can sustain them with powerful AoE heals.

As a wielder of Radiant Runes, he must choose how and when to cast his most powerful spells.

His strong Direct Healing grant him an advantage in reacting to an ever-changing battlefield.

talents.name: Master of Triage
talents.description:
Each time you generate a Radiant Rune, a free Greater Heal of 30% efficiency is cast on a nearby ally, preferring the player with lowest health.
Master of Triage does not trigger Rune of Renewal healing

talents.name: Enduring Light
talents.description: The healing of your Circle of Light is increased by up to 50% depending on the amount of health the target is missing. Lower health gives a larger bonus.

talents.name: Epiphany
talents.description:
Each time you cast Dawnflare, Soulbrand or Radiant Blast you have a 10% chance to grant you Epiphany for 15 seconds.
EPIPHANY
Your next Dawnbreaker Orb has no cost and does not trigger its cooldown.

talents.name: Alacritous Healing
talents.description: Your Greater Heal has 0.5 seconds reduced cast time and 20% increased Critical Strike chance.

talents.name: Well of Knowledge
talents.description: Your Mana Regeneration is increased by your Haste.

talents.name: Runic Revelations
talents.description: Your Soulbrand, Rune of Renewal & Luminous Barrier have 25% increased duration.

talents.name: Sacred Barrier
talents.description: Allies under the effects of any absorbs created from your hero abilities take 10% reduced damage.

talents.name: Ruptured Soul
talents.description: When an enemy dies while Soulbrand is active on them you instantly gain 50% of the Radiant Rune power it would have generated in the time that was remaining and trigger an explosion dealing 25% of the damage that was remaining to all nearby enemies.

talents.name: Meticulous Runesmith
talents.description: When your Dawnbreaker Orb heals a player, 100% of that healing is also applied as an absorb shield on that player for 12 seconds.

talents.name: Bracing Light
talents.description: When you cast Lightshaper's Ward on an ally, it is also applied to you.

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% less Magic damage.

talents.name: Spirited Fortitude
talents.description: You take 10% less Area of effect damage.

talents.name: Radiant Soul
talents.description:
Your Radiant Blast adds 3 seconds to the duration of all your active Rune of Renewal, Soulbrand, and Luminous Barrier effects.
Rune of Renewal's healing, Luminous Barrier's absorb, and Soulbrand's damage is increased by 25%.

talents.name: Ascending Avatar
talents.description: Your Levitate ability grants you Avatar of Light for 6 seconds.

talents.name: Grand Design
talents.description:
Your Soulbrand, Rune of Renewal & Luminous Barrier abilities can now be Overcharged, causing the ability to be cast on up to 4 applicable targets at once at 76% power.
Requires and costs 2 Radiant Runes
Overcharged Abilities
Hold down the relevant ability button until a cast bar is displayed. Once the cast has completed, the overcharged version of the ability will trigger.

talents.name: Dawnbreaker's Legacy
talents.description: Your Dawnbreaker Orb's Critical Strike chance is increased by 25%.

talents.name: Expansive Mind
talents.description:
Your Dawnflare casts have a chance to grant you Expansive Mind, increasing your Spirit by 20% for 12 seconds and replenishing 1% max mana every 2 seconds for the duration.
(1.2 PPM)

talents.name: Beacon in the Dark
talents.description:
Your Dawnflare and Radiant Blast abilities have a 15% chance to grant you Beacon in the Dark, causing your next Radiant Blast to have an additional 50% Critical Strike chance.
Upon gaining Beacon in the Dark the cooldown of Radiant Blast is instantly reset.

talents.name: Perfect Circle (old)
talents.description: Your Circle of Light costs 25% less Mana.

talents.name: Epiphany (old)
talents.description:
Your Dawnflare, Soulbrand & Radiant Blast have a 15% chance to make your next Greater Heal instant cast and cost 50% less Mana.
Epiphany stacks up to 3 times.

talents.name: Greater Soulbrand (old)
talents.description:
Your Soulbrand deals 20% increased damage.
- NUUKED - needs redesign - Axel

talents.name: Meticulous Runesmith (old)
talents.description: Your Dawnbreaker Orb costs 1 less Radiant Rune.

talents.name: Rite of Dawn (old)
talents.description: The damage and healing of your Radiant Blast is increased by 20%.

lore: Vigour taps into the very essence of light with ease—a power he uses to defend those in need from the many forms of darkness that seek to corrupt the world. His sacred duty is not only to heal the wounded but also to strike down those who would use shadows to harm the innocent.

abilities.name: Pummel
abilities.description:
Instantly interrupt target enemy's spell cast, and silence them for 4 seconds.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Thunder Call
abilities.description:
Call on Thunder to charge your hammer with immense power, enhancing your abilities for 20 seconds.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description:
Instantly intimidate up to 8 enemies around you for 10 seconds.
If an Intimidated enemy takes damage equal to 2000% of your Strength, they will break out of the effect.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Focused Wrath
abilities.description:
Your next two casts of Skull Crusher or Hammer Storm cost 50% less Fury and deal 50% increased damage.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Unbreakable Will
abilities.description:
You take 40% reduced damage for 4 seconds.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

name: Tariq
description:
Tariq channels storm and fury to deal immense damage to his enemies.

Tariq is a Melee Damage Dealer that uses Builder/Spender and Timing Mechanics. He excels in the front lines to flank his enemies while they face the Tank.

Timing his abilities around his Swing Timer will maximize his damage and Fury generation.

Fury is required for Tariq to perform powerful attacks.

talents.name: Left Hand Path
talents.description:
When Face Breaker deals critical strike damage, 30% of the damage dealt is also dealt to enemies near your target, reduced beyond 5 targets.
Face Breaker's critical strike chance is increased by +50%.

talents.name: Concatenation
talents.description: Your Attack Speed is increased by 50%.

talents.name: Blood & Thunder
talents.description:
Your Heavy Strike has a chance to cast a free Chain Lightning at the target
(2.0 PPM)

talents.name: Bloodline
talents.description:
You generate 1 Fury every 1 second.
You no longer lose Fury while out of combat.

talents.name: High Road
talents.description:
When your Leap Smash ability does not hit an enemy, its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds and your movement speed is increased by 50% for 4 seconds.
Your Leap Smash has +20% increased critical strike chance.
You now only generate Fury with Leap Smash when it deals damage to an enemy.

talents.name: Ride the Lightning
talents.description: Your Thunder Call generates 60 Fury over its duration.

talents.name: Them Bones
talents.description:
Your Skull Crusher has a 30% chance to have +100% increased critical strike chance.
GRIEVOUS CRITICAL STRIKE
Any critical strike chance you have beyond 100% causes a grievous critical strike. Grievous critical strikes increase the base damage of the hit by an amount equal to the overflowing critical strike chance.

talents.name: Kill 'Em All
talents.description: Your Hammer Storm now spins 3 times per use for the same Fury cost, but each consecutive spin deals 35% more damage.

talents.name: Thunderstruck
talents.description: Your Chain Lightning bounces 3 additional times.

talents.name: Pneuma
talents.description:
While Thunder Call is active you take 10% reduced damage.
Additionally, you are healed for 5% of all damage you deal during Thunder Call.

talents.name: Far Beyond Driven
talents.description:
Each time you use Heavy Strike you gain 1 stack of Far Beyond Driven for 20 seconds, increasing your Spirit by +2%.
Far Beyond Driven stacks up to 5 times.

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% reduced Magic damage.

talents.name: Mouth for War
talents.description: When your Leap Smash ability deals damage, you are granted 1 charge of Focused Wrath.

talents.name: Schism
talents.description:
Your Skull Crusher has a chance to make your next Hammer Storm deal 300% increased damage.
Your Hammer Storm has a chance to make your next Skull Crusher deal 300% increased damage.
(1.2 PPM)

talents.name: Square Hammer
talents.description:
Wild Swing, Face Breaker, Leap Smash & Chain Lightning each grant you 1 stack of Square Hammer, up to 5 stacks.
SQUARE HAMMER
Your next Heavy Strike consumes all stacks of Square Hammer and deals 30% more damage per stack consumed.

talents.name: Spit It Out
talents.description: Your Critical Strike Power is increased by 10%.

talents.name: Spirited Fortitude
talents.description: You take 10% less damage from Area of Effect attacks.

talents.name: Crack the Sky
talents.description: Your Lightning damage has +25% increased critical strike chance.

talents.name: Spirited Advance (old)
talents.description: Your Movement Speed is increased by 20%

lore: Tariq comes from a long line of champions. He is strong of hand and stronger of heart. He lived a simple life of calm and peace, but one fateful day, his partner and child were lost in the wars of the Clans.

abilities.name: Fighting Techniques
abilities.description:
Grants access to Finishing Moves based on Combo Builders used:
Finisher Techniques can be used during Global Cooldown
PALM TECHNIQUES
Double Palm Strike
• Grants +20% Magic Damage reduction & +5% Parry for 15 sec.
Spirited Vortex
• Conjures a Vortex around you that provides +5% Dodge, deals damage to nearby enemies over 18 seconds, and reduces their movement speed by 35% for 5 seconds.
KICK TECHNIQUES
Rising Storm
• Deals damage to the target and grants 2 Stormfall charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Lashing Stormkicks by 100%.
Lashing Stormkick
• Deals damage to target and nearby enemies nearby. Heals you for 200% of the damage it deals.
FIST TECHNIQUES
Rising Earth
• Deals damage to the target and grants 2 Earthfall charges, increasing the damage of your next 2 Earthfist Barrages by 100%.
Earthfist Barrage
• Pummels target enemy over 2 seconds and heals you for 200% of the damage it deals.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description:
Taunt the target, forcing it to attack you for 6 sec.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.description:
Quickly travel forward a short distance.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Stagger
abilities.description:
Interrupt the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec.
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.description:
Create a Cyclone of strong winds that instantly pulls in all enemies within the radius to you.
Can be used during Global Cooldown

abilities.name: Twin Souls: Bulwark
abilities.description:
Split your soul into the Sibling of Wind and the Sibling of Earth for up to 20 seconds.
SIBLING OF WIND (controlled)
The Sibling of Wind takes 20% of any damage dealt to the Sibling of Earth..
SIBLING OF EARTH
The Sibling of Earth taunts all enemies in a 1000 radius around them every 1.5 seconds. If the Sibling of Earth is destroyed before the duration ends, Twin Souls: Bulwark ends.

name: Meiko
description:
As a martial artist, Meiko utilizes a variety of fighting techniques to empower herself and defend her allies.

Meiko is a Melee Tank that uses Ability Combo Mechanics. She excels in the front lines taking hits instead of her allies.

She uses Ability Combos to perform powerful Finishing Moves.

Big cooldowns and self buffs allow her to mend her own wounds and survive dangerous attacks.

talents.name: Resonance of Earth
talents.description: When you activate Stone Shield you take 20% reduced damage for 8 seconds.

talents.name: Perfect Storm
talents.description: Your Lashing Stormkick has a 50% chance to deal damage an additional time for 30% of the initial hit.

talents.name: Will of Stone
talents.description: Your Shatter Earth now also activates your Spirited Strikes and Spirited Vortex buffs with 100% increased duration.

talents.name: Thundering Kicks
talents.description: Your Lashing Stormkick has 20% increased Critical Strike chance.

talents.name: Harsh Winds
talents.description: Your Spirited Vortex damage is increased by 20%

talents.name: Earthen Guard
talents.description: Your Earth abilities deal 20% increased damage

talents.name: Earthwell
talents.description: Each hit with Earthfist Barrage adds 1 stack to your Serenity ability.

talents.name: Debilitating Vortex
talents.description: Enemies hit by Spirited Vortex have 20% reduced Auto Attack speed for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Unwavering Spirit
talents.description:
The Spirit Armor buff you gain whenever you trigger a Spirit Refund now also grants you a shield for 12 seconds absorbing up to 1642% Agility damage.
Your Spirit is increased by +3% passively.

talents.name: Slipstream
talents.description: Each time you cast Gust you release a burst of winds at your starting location, causing all enemies within 750 radius to have 50% reduced movement speed for 6 seconds.

talents.name: Magic Ward
talents.description: You take 10% less Magic damage.

talents.name: Spirited Advance
talents.description: Your Movement Speed is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Serene Resilience
talents.description: Your Serenity applies 0.7% damage reduction for 9 seconds per stack consumed.

talents.name: Earthbourne
talents.description: Your Shatter Earth now has 30 seconds less cooldown and each cast of Shatter Earth reduces the cooldown of Twin Souls: Bulwark by 15%.

talents.name: Forbidden Technique
talents.description:
Your Double Palm Strike finisher applies Forbidden Technique to the target for 15 seconds.
Forbidden Technique accumulates 15% of all damage you deal to the target. Once it expires, is removed, or if the enemy dies while it is active - the accumulated amount explodes on the target and onto nearby enemies. You are healed for 100% of the damage dealt by Forbidden Technique.
You can only have one Forbidden Technique active at any time.

talents.name: Peacefield
talents.description: Your Serenity applies Peacefield on you, healing you for 25% of the healing done over 9 seconds.

talents.name: Superior Bulwark
talents.description: The health and duration of your Twin Souls: Bulwark sibling is increased by 20%.

talents.name: Conclusive Strikes
talents.description: Your Finishers deal 10% increased damage.

lore: Evil destroyed her home and her purpose, now only she remains. Meiko cannot undo what has happened to her people, but she can avenge them. That will be her purpose now.
